title: Delete a reservoir edge to obtain a valid hard physical flow
statement: The reconstructed physical flow begins at actual all-minus and ends at majority; deleting its preceding star-to-a edge can only reduce resistance. The same normalization therefore yields hard C*/ZA>exp(-6251). Restricting the bbox trial to physical edges is admissible and deletes reservoir energy, retaining Wbbox,physical/C*<exp20. Hard and soft capacities are different; this proof does not assert equality or remove the hard residence numerator.
